resources.string: Xiaomi/Redmi Setup Guide
Settings → My Device → All Specs → Tap MIUI Version 7 times
Settings → Additional Settings (HyperOS: My Device) → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
On newer Xiaomi devices, you must wait 7 days after enabling Developer Options before Wireless Debugging becomes available
Go to Settings → Battery → Set TabTin to unrestricted background usage
OPPO Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Tap Build Number 7 times
Settings → System Settings → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
Go to Settings → Battery → App Power Consumption → Set TabTin to unrestricted
vivo/iQOO Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Tap Software Version 7 times
Settings → System Management → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
Go to i Manager → App Management → Disable battery optimization for TabTin
Huawei Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Tap Build Number 7 times
Settings → System & Updates → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
HarmonyOS NEXT devices do not support Wireless Debugging
Go to Settings → Battery → App Launch Management → Set TabTin to manual
Honor Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Tap Build Number 7 times
Settings → System & Updates → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
Go to Settings → Battery → App Launch Management → Set TabTin to manual
Samsung Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Software Information → Tap Build Number 7 times
Settings → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
Samsung Device Care auto-optimizes background apps. Add TabTin to the "Unmonitored apps" list
If Knox security policies are enabled, ensure they do not restrict Developer Options
OnePlus Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Tap Build Number 7 times
Settings → System Settings → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
Go to Settings → Battery → Battery Optimization → Set TabTin to "Don\'t optimize"
realme Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Tap Build Number 7 times
Settings → System Settings → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
Go to Settings → Battery → Battery Optimization → Set TabTin to "Don\'t optimize", and disable auto-cleanup in Phone Manager
Motorola Setup Guide
Developer Mode Setup Guide
Settings → About Phone → Tap Build Number 7 times to enable Developer Options
Settings → Developer Options → Enable "USB Debugging" and "Wireless Debugging"
Tap "Pair device with pairing code" on the Wireless Debugging page
